Is video mein humne Mahindra XEV 9e ko cover kiya hai, jo kuch time pehle pahad se girne ke baad completely damaged ho gayi thi।

Lekin Mahindra body shop aur insurance company (ICICI Lombard) ki aapas ki milibhagat ke chalte, is gaadi ko total loss declare nahi kiya gaya.
Iske bajay gaadi ko repair kar diya gaya, jiske baad se is car mein rozana hazaron tarah ki problems aa rahi hain।

Aapse request hai ki yeh video poori zaroor dekhein, taaki aapko clear samajh aa sake ki car kharidte waqt sahi insurance company choose karna kitna zaroori hota hai.
